actions.action: Give the plants a thorough watering
Water more often while the plants are outdoors in sun
Repot into larger pots that hold more water
Add a layer of mulch over the soil
Move plants to shade or put a shade cover over them during the hottest part of the day
Check whether the plants perk back up at night or early morning
Replace the clear containers or shield them from light so the roots don't overheat

verdict.reason: The answer is a pasted thread dump, but its dominant and repeated message is that the plants are dehydrated and need water, which matches the confirmed drought stress and fix; the side suggestions (shade, hardening off) are not harmful.
